ns2:course.label: Orthopedic Sports Medicine
ns2:course.description: The student participating in this elective will gain initial exposure to Orthopedic Sports Medicine both in the clinic setting and in the operating room. The student will work one-on-one with the faculty in the operating room and clinic in the care of orthopedic sports medicine patients. This elective can be tailored to the individual student’s needs, interest, and educational level. No graduate credit. 2 professional hours. Approved for S/U grading only.
